counterexample: Let G be the trivial group and V be k^2 with trivial G-action. V is a G-module over an algebraically closed field k, but End_G(V) = M_2(k) is not a field. The theorem fails because V is not required to be irreducible (and the proof fails to justify steps 0009 and 0021 due to missing finite-dimensional and irreducible hypotheses).
